entities.name: Methanol (CO)
observations: Retrieved closely matching Suzuki-type records used methanol as solvent; yields ranged 73.2–78.1%, including 73.2% with sodium hydroxide. THF and DMF were not present in the retrieved set.

entities.name: Solvent evidence
observations: Methanol is the only directly supported choice among methanol, THF, and DMF in closely matching coupling records; comparison does not prove intrinsic superiority.
